desc: Analyze the problem and identify that simple adjacent pairing DP is insufficient due to nested pairs.
Derive the correct DP recurrence: `dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], max_{j < i, i-j odd} (dp[j-1] + |A[i] - A[j]|))`.
Optimize the recurrence using running maximums for `dp[j-1] - A[j]` and `dp[j-1] + A[j]` based on parity of `j`.
Implement the optimized DP solution in Python.
Test the solution with provided sample inputs.
